_desc: Social links — rendered as the hero icon row (with hover tooltips) and the footer 'Connect' buttons. Array order = display order. Only entries with a URL appear; removing/adding entries collapses/expands the layout automatically.
_sources: URLs provided by Mit in chat (2026-07-17). Order confirmed by Mit (revision request): LinkedIn, GitHub, X, Medium, Instagram, Facebook, Email. Pinterest removed per the same request. Icons render in the reference's Phosphor duotone style.

_fields.platform: One of: x, linkedin, github, youtube, instagram, pinterest, medium, facebook, email, other.
_fields.url: Full URL (or mailto: for email — "" on the email row auto-uses profile.json email).
_fields.label: Only needed for platform 'other' — the tooltip/aria label.
